name: Doomsday Confluence
oracle_text:
Choose X. You may choose the same mode more than once.
• Each player sacrifices a nonartifact creature of their choice.
• Create a 3/3 black Dalek artifact creature token with menace.
• Each opponent discards a card.
blocked_sentences: Choose X. You may choose the same mode more than once.

needs.what: a repeatable top-level choose_mode whose count is the spell's announced X ({"x": true}), asked at 601.2b after X is announced, choosing exactly X mode instances (zero when X is 0)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: choose_mode takes `repeatable` beside a literal `count` only. `count` is run through evaluate_value, but Game._ask_modes builds its EffectContext without the announced X (ctx.x defaults to 0), so {"x": true} would evaluate to 0 and modal_bounds then raises the floor to max(1, count), so the spell would always choose exactly one mode whatever X was paid. The three bullets are expressible on their own (sacrifice, create_token dalek_3_3_b_artifact_menace, discard); only the X-sized mode count is missing.
